summary.name: WikiSuite
summary.one_liner: WikiSuite is a free/libre open source enterprise software suite that bundles collaboration, data management, business, security and infrastructure tools, self-hosted or as SaaS.
keywords: open source alternative to google workspace
use_cases: Running a knowledge base or wiki for an organization
Self-hosting team chat, video conferencing and webmail
Managing ERP and CRM operations with open source tools
Centralized user access control and identity directory
Remote administration of servers and devices
Peer-to-peer file sync and versioned document storage
summary.what_it_does: WikiSuite is a curated suite of open source applications aimed at knowledge-centric organizations. The page groups its tools into communication (Cypht webmail, Prosody XMPP, BigBlueButton, Jitsi Meet, Converse), data and file management (Syncthing, Tiki Wiki, Tiki Trackers, Tiki File Galleries), business tools (Dolibarr ERP/CRM, Tiki Reports, Surveys, Diagram), security and identity (Tiki permissions, Webmin OpenLDAP), device infrastructure (MeshCentral, Virtualmin, Webmin), and governance (Tiki Revision History). It offers a web admin panel for configuration and is said to be available self-hosted or as Software as a Service. The page lists recent release announcements for included projects.
notable: Integrates many FLOSS applications (wiki, ERP/CRM, XMPP chat, conferencing, webmail, file sync, server admin) into one suite
Web admin panels let power users configure tools without editing config files
Optional paid support, consulting and customization from the architects, with no vendor lock-in
Supported on major Linux distros such as CentOS, Ubuntu and Debian per the announcement
caveats: Paid support, consulting and customization are optional add-ons
Listing notes licenses vary by component (GPL-3.0, LGPL-2.1, Apache-2.0, MPL, MIT, AGPL-3.0)
